_comment: Copy to config.json (or point ARTEX_CONFIG env var at another path). This file holds only database and skill_dir; LLM and other settings go through env vars or in-app settings, not here.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Precedence: env var ARTEX_PG_DSN > the database field here. Use one of two forms: (A) fill in the sub-fields below; (B) set only database.dsn to a full connection string.
_comment_database_dsn: Form (B): remove the database block above and use a full DSN instead. When dsn is non-empty the sub-fields are ignored.
_comment_skill_dir: Skill root directory (one skill per subdirectory, each containing a SKILL.md). Precedence: env var ARTEX_SKILL_DIR > this field > default (skills/ next to the executable). Leave empty or remove this field to use the default. Relative paths resolve against the current working directory.
